# RBC Indigio

> RBC Indigio is a private-wealth platform for tokenized real-estate investing and selected private-market opportunities.

## Public sections

- [Home](/): Platform overview and investor proposition.
- [Deals](/deals): Current tokenized real-estate and private-credit opportunities.
- [Projects](/projects): Mining, agriculture, oil and gas, and philanthropy sectors.
- [About](/about): Company history and business profile.
- [Contact](/contact): Official contact details and investor enquiries.

## Investor access

Account registration, KYC onboarding, package selection, portfolio data, deposits, and withdrawals require authenticated access. Investment packages are subject to suitability, verification, availability, and administrator review.
